mapper.insert: insert into mcp_tool_registry ( gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{gatewayId}, #{toolName}, #{toolKey}, #{toolDescription}, #{httpUrl}, #{httpMethod}, #{httpHeaders}, #{timeout}, #{retryTimes}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update mcp_tool_registry set gateway_id = #{gatewayId}, tool_name = #{toolName}, tool_key = #{toolKey}, tool_description = #{toolDescription}, http_url = #{httpUrl}, http_method = #{httpMethod}, http_headers = #{httpHeaders}, timeout = #{timeout}, retry_times = #{retryTimes}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_registry where id = #{id}

select id, gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_registry where gateway_id = #{gatewayId} and tool_name = #{toolName}

select id, gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_registry where gateway_id = #{gatewayId} order by id desc

select id, gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_registry where gateway_id = #{gatewayId} and status = 1 order by id desc

select id, gateway_id, tool_name, tool_key, tool_description, http_url, http_method, http_headers, timeout, retry_times, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_registry where gateway_id = #{gatewayId} order by id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
